item.title: Legal encounters may offer overlooked opportunities for suicide prevention, analysis suggests
item.description: Picture a forlorn man walking into a lawyer's office after his marriage has collapsed. The bank is threatening foreclosure, and his finances are in tatters. His problems may be legal on paper, but in person they can look far more complicated: panic, shame or the numb resignation of someone who can no longer imagine a way out. He did not come for counseling, and his lawyer is not a therapist. item.title: Sapphire-grown semiconductor film sets bandgap record
item.description: Semiconductors with wider bandgaps could pave the way for smaller, more efficient electronics that can handle far higher voltages, but the wider this gap becomes, the harder it is to control how well a material conducts electricity. Their research has been published in Nature. Fuente: Phys.org.
